title: Minimalistic way to be an absolute unit
author: Maxime-Terrence M.
desc: To become strong and athletic an absolute animal as simply as possible

ex.note: Use body weight to start but goal is to gradually increase to weighted pull ups i find this easiest with getting a weight vest with inserts and removing all the weights and starting with one insert
Use bodyweight to start, progressively increase the height of the level of your feet until you’re able to do it without any leverage.
Goal here is to gradually increase weight when all sets and reps are completed add more weight and work at that weight until prescribed sets and reps are reached then add weight again
Hang or hold yourself on whatever is available complete the reps
Broad jumping for maximum distance here be explosive
These are shorter sprints today so give it your all leave everything here to finish the day off strong
Once all sets and reps completed increase weight keep following this progression to keep strength gains coming
Same as squats
Here your rpe completely depends on your own effort so make sure to give it your all and explode with every jump be fast
Easy jog to finish up the day and to get fresh blood into legs to help recovery
Really stretch and focus on mobility get everything loose and feeling good spend extra time on problem areas
Increase weight when all sets and reps are achieved
Find starting weight and increase when reps are achieved
Pause at the concentric hold for 2 seconds and return to your isometric hold for 3 seconds.
Go slow feel the burn
These are longer sprints make sure to rest 2-5 minutes between sprint sets even if you arent winded this is to ensure you are giving it max effort
Heavy as possible while maintaining form try to increase weight weekly
Be explosive work on catching bar in a quarter squat position to get the added benefit of the catch note do not catch in a full squat we are working power here so quarter squat is as deep as you get
Here just grab a heavy weight and start walking until your grip gives out then rest 5 minutes and do it again until sets are completed
